label: WaterMelonControl
description: WaterMelonControl adds Karoo data page widgets for sideloaded media apps, including now playing, playback controls, tap-to-open, and device music volume control.
releaseNotes:
### Version 1.3.2

- Adds Karoo package detail metadata with developer name, About text, release notes, icon, and fixed APK URL.
- Enables Karoo update detection through manifest latestVersion/latestVersionCode metadata.
- Keeps Karoo 2 compatibility fixes from 1.3.1 beta builds.
- Excludes temporary beta03 notification diagnostic logging.
